newsitem.title: USA: Fed's Greenspan to wed Mitchell - Washington Post.
newsitem.headline: Fed's Greenspan to wed Mitchell - Washington Post.

text.p: Federal Reserve Chairman Alan Greenspan has proposed to NBC-TV correspondent Andrea Mitchell after 12 years of dating, and the two expect to get married in Washington this spring, the Washington Post reported on Tuesday.
"We have a huge amount in common. It's a really great match," Greenspan told the Post on Monday.
According to the report, Greenspan proposed on Christmas Day after he and Mitchell had spent Christmas morning with friends.
"We came home and he said, 'Do you want a big wedding or a small wedding?'" Mitchell said.
Greenspan, who is 70, and Mitchell, who is 20 years his junior, were both married previously.
